generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted

The bidder should have satisfactorily completed at least one similar nature of work for Supply, Laying & Commissioning of OFC LAN along with wireless Point to Point Radio Modems and should have successfully executed at least one single work in the same field having all components in any particular work with contract value not less than Rs. 1.78 Lakhs in reputed organizations as a prime contractor in the last five years i.e. from 2021-22 to 2025-26. (The value of the completed works shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the FY in which the tenders are invited.) Certificate to that extent shall be issued by the competent authority not below the rank of Chief Engineer in case of KPCL/RPCL works and not below the rank of Executive Engineer in case of other Government organization or competent authority in reputed companies/organizations and shall be uploaded/submitted

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- work/job order along with relavent work done certificate

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder out of the past five financial years (i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26) should have a minimum average annual financial turnover of not less than Rs.7 Lakhs in any two financial years. (Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weight age of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the FY in which the tenders are invited) and shall be uploaded/submitted.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall visit site and inspect the FOIS buildings, site conditions and requirement. Bidder shall upload a certificate of having visited the site who can able to provide FOIS railways Freight Operations Information System related works and services for extending FOIS to in-motion weighbridge system and having shown the credentials and understood the scope of work in detail duly obtaining acknowledgment towards proof of visit and acceptance of scope.
